# Base image with build tools and a modern compiler
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Install dependencies: build tools, git, cmake, OpenMPI, and certificates
# Using non-interactive frontend to prevent prompts during build
RUN apt-get update && \
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    cmake \
    git \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments
# - Allow running as root
# - Disable memory-sharing mechanisms that can cause issues in containers
# - Explicitly use TCP over the primary network interface (eth0)
# - Disable InfiniBand/RoCE which are typically not available
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0

# Set a working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Clone the Kripke repository and its submodules from the 'master' branch
RUN git clone --depth 1 --recurse-submodules --branch master https://github.com/LLNL/Kripke.git /app/Kripke

# Build Kripke with MPI and OpenMP enabled for CPU execution
# FIX: Corrected CMake flags to use ENABLE_MPI and ENABLE_OPENMP as required by the BLT build system.
RUN mkdir -p /app/Kripke/build && \
    cd /app/Kripke/build && \
    cmake \
        -D ENABLE_MPI=ON \
        -D ENABLE_OPENMP=ON \
        .. && \
    make -j$(nproc)

# Copy the compiled executable to a system location on the PATH
RUN cp /app/Kripke/build/bin/kripke.exe /usr/local/bin/kripke

# Clean up the source code to reduce image size
RUN rm -rf /app/Kripke

# Set the final working directory
WORKDIR /root

# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to deploy the Kripke benchmark
# application on a single AWS CPU-based Kubernetes node using the Flux Operator.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: kripke-minicluster-aws-cpu
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # We are running on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run across all pods.
  tasks: 2

  # Logging mode for the Flux Operator. Strict will fail on any logging error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods when the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Define the application container to be run by the Flux Operator.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # This is the main application container, not a launcher pod.
      launcher: false
      # The command to execute. The Flux Operator will automatically wrap this
      # with 'flux run -n <tasks> ...' because runFlux is true.
      command: kripke --zones 12,12,12 --niter 2
      # Ensures the command is executed under the Flux instance.
      runFlux: true

# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to deploy the Kripke benchmark
# application on a single AWS CPU-based Kubernetes node using the Flux Operator.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: kripke-minicluster-aws-cpu
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # We are running on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run.
  tasks: 64

  # Logging mode for the Flux Operator. Strict will fail on any logging error.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods when the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    container:
      # Specify the Flux container image, optimized for the ARM architecture of hpc7g instances.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-specific configurations.
  pod:
    # Schedule the MiniCluster pod on a specific AWS Graviton instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"

  # Define the application container to be run by the Flux Operator.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # This is the main application container, not a launcher pod.
      launcher: false
      # FIX: Adjusted --zones to be divisible by --procs. 16 is divisible by 8.
      # This resolves the assertion failure: "Number of zones in X must evenly divide into the number of subdomains"
      command: kripke --zones 16,16,16 --niter 10 --procs 8,8,1
      # Ensures the command is executed under the Flux instance.
      runFlux: true
